messages:
maya: Deploying release r5.2.1 to canary now — starts at 11:02 PT. I'll kick off smoke once canary is up. @zach you'll get routing update.
zach: on it, watching canary endpoints. notify when tests are green.
sasha: quick heads up: metrics dashboard link https://dash.redwood.ai/r/abc123 — watch p50/p90 latency and error-rate. set alert if errors > 0.5%.
oncall-bot: Canary deployment succeeded (pods: 3/3). Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/c/xyz
maya: canary healthy, running smoke script now:
```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --target canary --checks basic,embeddings,kv-cache
```
qa-jen: running local checks against canary, will post failures.
linh: added a temporary routing rule to limit traffic to 10%.
qa-jen: smoke results: basic ok, embeddings task: PASS, rerank latency spike ~120ms to 180ms p95 — small bump.
zach: saw that spike on traces, looks like a cold-start of llama-cache shard. p90 steady. no increased errors.
maya: rolling a quick kernel-config tweak (reduce batch_size_hint to 8) to see if p95 stabilizes. patch pushed: commit 6a1f2b3
oncall-bot: Patch deployed to canary runtime (6a1f2b3). Restarting 3 workers.
qa-jen: re-run smoke: embeddings p95 back to 135ms, errors 0.02% — good.
sasha: metrics look normal, CPU up a touch but within target. I'll keep monitoring 30m.
maya: planning rollout to prod in 20m, canary looks safe. Rollback plan ready (switch routing to previous variant v5.2.0, scale down canary). @zach can you be ready to flip if needed?
zach: ready. will standby and keep watch on pager.
linh: noted, config flag r5.2.1-prod-ready set true.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll post post-rollout notes in #eng-releases when prod pass completes :thumbsup:
